content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Bangalore Web Developer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Bangalore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM Bangalore) for filling up Web Developer positions under advertisement number IIMB/HR/RECT/2026/56.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Web Developer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Web Developer position in this recruitment drive offered by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIM Bangalore Web Developer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application form for the Web Developer position at IIM Bangalore is 15-10-2026. Ensure you submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience in web development, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Web Developer position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Web Developer position will receive a competitive salary package of Rs. 8.85 Lakhs Per Annum as per the institutional norms and guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee is Nil for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIM Bangalore Web Developer 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for the Web Developer position must be submitted strictly through online mode by visiting the official recruitment portal or using the direct link provided.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Web Developer position at IIM Bangalore primarily involves shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and relevant experience profiles.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the IIM Bangalore Web Developer position?
faq.answer: The Web Developer position offered by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore is contractual in nature, providing a great opportunity for experienced IT professionals.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidates who clear the recruitment process for the Web Developer position will be Bangalore, Karnataka.
